description: It is non-toxic, non-flammable and ready to use.
whereToUse: As a bonding agent over polystyrene or urethane foam insulation prior to application of Zonolite 3306 Thermal Barrier
As a bonding agent over primed/painted structural steel (columns, beams and joists)
As a bonding agent over concrete floor and/or roof units (including slab, pan joist, hollow-core or pre-cast plant or TEE units)
As a bonding agent for use over any approved substrate prior to application of Sonotex range of products
As a surface sealer (where specified) over any of the above products.
notFor: The fire protection product should be substantially dry prior to sealer application.
The use of a surface sealer over Sonotex 1 or any acoustical treatment may reduce the NRC value of the installed product.

technicalData.label: Application
technicalData.value: Graco Encapsulator II or airless spray equivalent, roller or brush.

technicalData.label: Clean up
technicalData.value: Tools and drippings should be cleaned with soapy water
